pretreatment: cleaned with chemical detergent, facilitated by ultrasonication, with water, acetone and iso-propanol successively
evidence: FTO glass with sheet resistance of 15 Ω/□ was cleaned with chemical detergent, facilitated by ultrasonication, with water, acetone and iso-propanol successively prior to PEALD of SnO2. ITO/PET (45 Ω/□) substrate was cleaned by the same procedure.
